about_the_game:
Diverse and Unique Units

The game features a total of 10 races: Dungeon, Infernals, Imperials, Barbarian, Mechanicals, Elves, Celestials, Tower, Undead, Orcs. There are over 100 distinct units (with 62 available at launch), each with unique skills. New units will be continuously added in future updates or DLC.

Resource management & Army Cultivation

Various random loot box mechanics for players to develop their ideal, distinctive army.
In the Training Grounds, you can collect fragments of units you’ve unlocked to upgrade them.
The game does not include in-game purchases, with all resources being reasonably configured and accessible through various methods.


Strategically Designed Combat

Choose your preferred or most suitable units to deploy. Combat is entirely skill-based, with no random elements – victory depends solely on your tactical unit configuration.
Choose the right formation and strategy to counter your opponent’s units effectively.
Utilize the reinforcement system to turn the tide of battle or dominate your foes.
Combine the abilities of your units to enjoy creative synergies and unexpected fun through combat.
You can also explore mysterious caves, defeat powerful enemies, and claim unrivaled wealth and glory.

PvP Challenges

You can upload your defensive formation to the Ladder system for other players to challenge or match up against real player formations.
Break through the formation of other players and prove to be the ultimate spear or the toughest shield.

short_description: Warlord is a strategy game set in a fantasy world filled with mythical creatures. As a commander, you will build and lead your own army. Experiment with unique strategies and tactics to dive into an unmatched experience across various game modes.
